entities.summary: Fajã de Baixo is a civil parish in the municipality of Ponta Delgada in the Portuguese archipelago of the Azores. The population in 2011 was 5,050, in an area of 4.06 km2. Faja de Baixo is located in the western part of the island of São Miguel, northeast of central Ponta Delgada.
